title: Diffusion-Based Trajectory Optimization for Autonomous Robotic Systems
summary: Trajectory synthesis in complex non-convex robotic workspaces requires balancing collision avoidance and temporal smoothness. We present a conditional score-based diffusion model that models trajectory generation as reverse stochastic differential equations. By conditioning diffusion steps on geometric obstacles, our approach synthesizes collision-free trajectories in 12ms on edge compute platforms, maintaining a 99.2% feasibility rate across 500 benchmark configurations.
